fallback.confidence_note: Generated only from the last {dayCount} days of recorded data. This is not a diagnosis or treatment advice.
fallback.summary_default: The last {dayCount} days of records were updated. You can keep strengthening the daily routine based on what is already logged.
fallback.summary_needs_attention: Medication completion was about {medicationValue}% over the last {dayCount} days and average water intake was about {waterValue}L, so a few basic habits are still worth tightening up.
fallback.summary_stable: Medication records looked fairly steady over the last {dayCount} days, and hydration also showed some continuity. Keeping the current rhythm is reasonable.
fallback.bullet_medication_tracked: {medicationTrackedDays} of the last {dayCount} days contain medication records, with current completion performance around {medicationValue}%.
fallback.bullet_medication_missing: There are not enough medication records across the last {dayCount} days yet. The report summary will be more reliable after more logging.
fallback.bullet_hydration_tracked: Average water intake was about {waterValue}L across the last {dayCount} days, and a few lower days are still worth tightening up.
fallback.bullet_hydration_missing: There are not enough water records across the last {dayCount} days yet. Start with logging the daily hydration rhythm more consistently.
fallback.bullet_sleep_tracked: {sleepTrackedDays} of the last {dayCount} days already contain sleep data. Keeping that continuity will make the report more useful.
fallback.bullet_sleep_missing: Real sleep data is still missing, so the report summary remains incomplete.
